title: The Burning Bush
backstory: Israel lived in Egypt four hundred and thirty years (Exodus 12:40). Joseph's family became a nation there, and then a new king "which knew not Joseph" set taskmasters over them and loaded them with burdens (Exodus 1:8-11). Moses was born a Hebrew, raised as the son of Pharaoh's daughter, and ran away to the desert after he killed an Egyptian (Exodus 2:10-15). He was eighty years old (Exodus 7:7) when a bush on the mountain caught fire and would not burn up.

passages.synopsis: While keeping his father-in-law's flock, Moses came to the mountain of God. There he saw a bush that burned with fire but was not consumed. As he turned to look, God called to him from the bush. God told him to remove his shoes, for he stood on holy ground, and named himself the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

God told Moses that he had seen the suffering of his people in Egypt. He was sending Moses to bring them out of slavery to a good land. Moses felt unworthy and asked, "Who am I, that I should go?" God promised, "Certainly I will be with thee."

Moses asked what name he should give when the people asked who sent him. God answered, "I AM THAT I AM," the God who always is. He promised to bring Israel out with a mighty hand and great wonders. Though Pharaoh would resist, God would surely deliver his people.

Moses worried the people would not believe him, so God gave him signs. His rod became a serpent, and his hand turned leprous and was healed. Still Moses hesitated, saying he was slow of speech. God promised to help him speak and gave him his brother Aaron to speak for him.

triviaQuestions.question: What was burning but not consumed when God called Moses?
triviaQuestions.explanation: Exodus 3:2 — "And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed."

triviaQuestions.question: What did God tell Moses to remove because he stood on holy ground?
triviaQuestions.explanation: Exodus 3:5 — "And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground."

triviaQuestions.question: What name did God give when Moses asked who was sending him?
triviaQuestions.explanation: Exodus 3:14 — "And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you."

triviaQuestions.question: To whom did God send Moses to bring Israel out of Egypt?
triviaQuestions.explanation: Exodus 3:10 — "Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt."

reflection: God met Moses in an ordinary place and called it holy. Where might God be meeting you?
